templates.name: Daily Morning Briefing
templates.description: Check calendar and email, give me today's priorities
templates.prompt: Check my calendar and email inbox. Give me: today's priorities, any urgent emails, meetings coming up, and one thing I should focus on first.

templates.name: Weekly Strategy Review
templates.description: Summarize the week and set priorities for next week
templates.prompt: Summarize this week: wins, decisions made, what's still open. Then set the top 3 priorities for next week.

templates.name: Weekly Content Calendar
templates.description: Plan this week's content based on current campaigns
templates.prompt: Plan this week's content calendar. Check what we've posted recently, what's performing, and create a 5-day posting schedule with ideas for each day.

templates.name: Daily Sales Pipeline Review
templates.description: Check pipeline status, flag stale deals, prep follow-ups
templates.prompt: Review the sales pipeline. Flag any deals that haven't moved in 5+ days. Draft follow-up messages for the top 3 stale deals.

templates.name: Monthly Client Health Report
templates.description: Generate monthly health report for all active clients
templates.prompt: Generate the monthly client health report. For each active client: wins this month, any concerns, recommended actions for next month.

templates.name: Weekly Competitor Scan
templates.description: Monitor competitor moves and market signals
templates.prompt: Run a competitor scan. Check what our top 3 competitors have posted, launched, or changed this week. Summarize key signals.
